Q1_domain_gap.note: coverage_at_q05 = fraction of that class reaching the 5th percentile of log p_mix on the pseudo-fakes the mixture was fitted on. Low values mean real forgeries lie outside the support of the pseudo-fake model — the gap, in one number.

Q3_family_posterior.note: P(family | z), exact, from densities that share a region graph and are each exactly normalized. No real forgery and no mechanism label was used in fitting.

per_region.note: P(family | z_R) with p_f(z_R) an exact region marginal — a mechanism map over the face, in probabilities.

C5_calibration.note: the ratio is a log-odds by construction, so sigmoid(s) is a probability claim that can be right or wrong — not a score that only ranks.
